node.title: Celebrating 100,000 likes!!
node.prompts: character: aqua_(konosuba), character: darkness_(konosuba), character: megumin, character: yunyun_(konosuba), A medium shot from a low angle captures a chaotic, high-energy party scene inside a lively fantasy tavern, where four distinct anime girls—Yunyun, Megumin, Aqua, and Darkness—are positioned around a cluttered wooden table in a balanced composition. Megumin stands proudly on a bench in the center, laughing triumphantly with her staff raised high overhead in both hands; Yunyun to her left reaches forward nervously with both hands outstretched, flustered and blushing deeply; Aqua on the right throws both arms up wildly, laughing brightly with mouth open; Darkness grips the table edge tightly with both hands, deeply flushed and tense with excitement. The table is a mess of wooden mugs, plates, spilled drinks, crumbs, scattered food, and messy tableware. The crowded tavern room features warm wooden beams, flickering lantern lighting, blurred patrons in the background, and rich fantasy details. The atmosphere is explosive with comedic turmoil, vivid anime colors, soft shadows, detailed expressive eyes, dramatic body language, flying motion lines, and vibrant lively energy.

extra.description:
It’s all thanks to everyone who always leaves a like. Thank you so much 🙇‍♂️✨
I got into Tsubaki2 a bit late, so I made this piece a lively one featuring the characters I use most often.
extra.naturalPrompts:
A high-quality anime illustration of Yunyun, Megumin, Aqua, and Darkness having a loud chaotic party inside a fantasy tavern. The scene is full of noisy energy, wild movement, and comedic disorder. Megumin is laughing proudly while standing on a bench and raising her staff dramatically. Yunyun is flustered and overwhelmed, trying to stop the chaos while blushing and reaching forward nervously. Aqua is the loudest one in the group, throwing both arms up, laughing brightly, and causing even more commotion. Darkness is deeply flushed, tense, and excited, gripping the edge of the table while trying to endure the chaos. Wooden mugs, plates, spilled drinks, crumbs, scattered food, and messy tableware are spread across the table. Everyone is animated, expressive, and clearly different from each other. The room feels lively, crowded, and out of control, with warm tavern lighting, dramatic body language, flying motion, vibrant expressions, rich fantasy interior details, balanced four-girl composition, clear separation between all four characters, vivid anime colors, detailed eyes, soft shadows, and a fun explosive party atmosphere.
